title: Utah Balloon Flights
specs: Private, premium, personalized hot air balloon experiences with no shared baskets
Flights operate in Eden and American Fork, Utah, with exceptional scenery
Hot air balloon marketing services with large branded balloons for high visibility
Min 16 years old for private pilot training, min 18 years old for commercial pilot training
Able to read, speak, write and understand English
Guests should be able to stand for about an hour
Guests should hold onto handles during landing and step into basket (door basket available with assistance)
Weight limits apply and are confirmed discreetly during booking
Private flights designed for 2 passengers, additional passengers possible for extra fee depending on balloon size and conditions

blurb: Guests experience private hot air balloon flights lasting about 3 hours including setup, flight, and celebration. Flights are private, typically for 2 passengers with options for additional passengers. The company also offers tethered rides, static displays, educational demonstrations, flight training, and custom advertising balloon services.
extraNote: Flights are weather dependent; may be rescheduled or refunded if conditions are unsafe · Booking recommended several weeks in advance · Exact meeting location provided the evening before flight, varies by weather and launch site.
